case_title: AMERICAN CHECK EXCHANGE DBA ANYKIND CHECK CASHING VS TRINITY PROPERTIES

docket_entries.description: SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT TRINITY PROPERTIES
UNTIMELY SERVICE AS TO TRINITY PROPERTY, NOT SERVED 20 DAYS PRIOR HRG. ON SUBSERVICE.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF AMERICAN CHECK EXCHANGE DBA ANYKIND CHECK CASHING CENTER IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT TRINITY PROPERTIES STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS

MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $731.54 FILED BY AMERICAN CHECK EXCHANGE DBA ANYKIND CHECK CASHING CENTER AS TO DEFENDANT TRINITY PROPERTIES ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-20-1993 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 08
